items.speaker: Neha Kapoor
items.text: Q3 campaign deck draft is 80% complete. She will send it to Arjun for review by Wednesday.

items.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
items.text: He committed to sending Raghav the updated vendor list by end of day tomorrow.

items.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
items.text: Mumbai office renewal paperwork requires sign-off this week. Ownership is unclear; Arjun advised flagging it rather than assuming responsibility.

items.speaker: Divya Rao
items.text: She was asked to prepare the July expense variance report before Thursday’s board prep. Divya confirmed it will be ready by Wednesday evening.

items.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
items.text: He will reconfirm the new meeting time directly with the Meridian Logistics team.

items.speaker: Neha Kapoor
items.text: Campaign deck review was initially scheduled for Wednesday, but Thursday morning was considered a safer option.
